purpose: Pixel check of the ACOS C1 capture in the WebView bounds (WV7 (c)).
method: ACOS capture steps of scenarios/webview-probe.yaml -> frames/<seq>.png (1080x2400 RGBA). WebView A display bounds rows 700..1260, B rows 1260..1820, x 21..921 (900x560 device px each, display origin 21).

before_fix.verdict: flat black: nothing the provider drew reached the captured window buffer

after_background_paint_fix.verdict: the region is now the provider's own pixels (page background, opaque white): the black rectangle was the provider's background Paint, whose default colour (opaque black) was never initialised from mBackgroundColor (0xFFFFFFFF).
after_background_paint_fix.page_text: not visible yet: the decoded engine frame is never painted, see no-draw-after-frame in this directory
